say:4:1510273001:0.text: Amazing... In the blink of an eye, all these people recovered!
say:4:1510273001:0.source_cn: 啊……这就是神的力量！我才眨了下眼，这些将死之人竟然恢复了！

say:5:1510273002:0.text: You're so merciful... I can't believe you used your powers on these human captives.
say:5:1510273002:0.source_cn: 狩猎神，多么仁慈……居然愿意对人类战俘施展神迹！
say:5:1510273002:0.male: You're so merciful... I can't believe you used your powers on these human captives.
say:5:1510273002:0.female: You're so merciful... I can't believe you used your powers on these human captives.

say:6:1510273003:0.text: The Herdmaster needs these captives alive as bargaining chips. No more mistakes can be made.
say:6:1510273003:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人需要俘虏们活着，作为筹码。不要再出差错。
say:6:1510273003:0.male: The Herdmaster needs these captives alive as bargaining chips. No more mistakes can be made.
say:6:1510273003:0.female: The Herdmaster needs these captives alive as bargaining chips. No more mistakes can be made.

say:11:1510273005:0.text: Herdmaster, now that the captives are out of danger. Should we return and meet with the envoy?
say:11:1510273005:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，俘虏没有了性命之忧，现在要回去见那位使者吗？
say:11:1510273005:0.male: Herdmaster, now that the captives are out of danger. Should we return and meet with the envoy?
say:11:1510273005:0.female: Herdmaster, now that the captives are out of danger. Should we return and meet with the envoy?

say:12:1510273006:1.text: I know you'd like to talk with her alone.
say:12:1510273006:1.source_cn: 感觉，您想和她单独谈谈。
say:12:1510273006:1.male: I know you'd like to talk with her alone.
say:12:1510273006:1.female: I know you'd like to talk with her alone.

say:13:1510273007:1.text: I can distract Kordan for you.
say:13:1510273007:1.male: I can distract Kordan for you.
say:13:1510273007:1.female: I can distract Kordan for you.

choice_prompt:14:1510273007.male: I can distract Kordan for you.
choice_prompt:14:1510273007.female: I can distract Kordan for you.

say:16:1510273009:1.text: No one has ever called me smart before.
say:16:1510273009:1.source_cn: 这样的夸奖，第一次听到。
say:16:1510273009:1.male: No one has ever called me smart before.
say:16:1510273009:1.female: No one has ever called me smart before.

say:17:1510273011:1.text: I'll make sure you have the time you need.
say:17:1510273011:1.source_cn: 加拉会把事情做好，请放心。

say:17:1510273011:1.female: I'll make sure you have the time you need.
